sources.content:
MEERA IYER
Junior Data Analyst · Pune, India
meera.iyer.data@example.com · +91 90000 23456 · linkedin.com/in/meera-iyer-data
public.tableau.com/app/profile/meera.iyer · medium.com/@meeraiyer

SUMMARY
Former mathematics teacher turned data analyst. I spent six years in the classroom and now build the dashboards and
SQL behind learner-engagement decisions at an edtech company. I like turning messy numbers into something a non-expert
can act on.

EXPERIENCE

Lumen Learning Labs — Junior Data Analyst                                              Pune · Feb 2025 – Present
Edtech company.
- Built the weekly learner-engagement dashboard in Tableau, used by 4 course teams.
- Wrote the SQL that joins quiz attempts to course completions (12 tables).
- Cut a manual Monday report from 3 hours to 20 minutes with a scheduled Google Sheets + BigQuery pipeline.

Greenfield Public School — Mathematics Teacher (grades 9–12)                          Pune · Jun 2018 – Dec 2023
- Taught 450+ students across six years.
- Built the school's Google Sheets grade tracker, used by 30 teachers.
- Coordinated the school's Olympiad programme.

PROJECTS
- Does attendance predict board results? (2024) — Analysis of a public Maharashtra school dataset (9,800 rows) in
  Python and pandas; found that attendance explains less than a third of the variance in results.
- Board results explorer (2024) — A public Tableau dashboard of district-level pass rates.
- Quiz-to-completion SQL case study (2024) — A written walkthrough of the Lumen engagement query.

CERTIFICATION
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate (Coursera), 2024. Self-directed projects in 2024.

EDUCATION
M.Sc. Mathematics — Savitribai Phule Pune University                                                 2016 – 2018
B.Ed.                                                                                                       2018

SKILLS
Analysis: SQL, BigQuery, Python (pandas), Excel, Google Sheets
Visualisation: Tableau
Statistics: descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression basics
Machine learning: scikit-learn (beginner)
Ways of working: explaining data to non-experts, written reports, assessment design

# Tableau Public: Meera Iyer

URL: https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/meera.iyer
Location: Pune
Bio: Maths teacher turned data analyst. I like dashboards a head teacher can read in a minute.
Followers: 23, following: 41

## Published dashboards (2)

### 1. Board results explorer
Published: 2024-08-17
Description: District-level pass rates for Maharashtra board exams, by year and stream.
Contents: a district map coloured by pass rate, a ranked table of districts, a year selector and a stream filter (Science, Commerce, Arts).
Data: public Maharashtra school results dataset.

### 2. Attendance and results by district
Published: 2024-09-29
Description: Scatter plot of average attendance against pass rate for each district, with a trend line and a tooltip per district.
Data: the same public dataset as her Python analysis (9,800 rows).

## Observations
- Both dashboards use a single headline number and one filter per view; titles say what the chart shows.
- No dashboard from work is public (the Lumen dashboard is internal).
- Dashboards have no written method note.

sources.label: Medium
sources.content:
# Medium: Meera Iyer (@meeraiyer)

URL: https://medium.com/@meeraiyer
Bio: Maths teacher turned data analyst, writing about data for people who do not do data. Pune.
Followers: 64

## Posts (3)
1. "Does attendance predict board results?" — 2024-10-06, 7 min read
   Walks through the analysis of a public Maharashtra school dataset (9,800 rows) in Python and pandas, and explains why
   attendance explaining less than a third of the variance is not the same as attendance not mattering.
2. "Six years of teaching, one lesson about messy data" — 2024-11-12, 5 min read
   What grading 450+ students by hand taught her about missing values, inconsistent labels and checking your own spreadsheet.
3. "Joins, explained for teachers" — 2025-03-02, 6 min read
   A gentle introduction to SQL joins using quiz attempts and course completions as the example tables.

## Observations
- Plain language throughout; each post opens with the question and the answer in two sentences.
- Last post is from March 2025; nothing since she started at Lumen Learning Labs.
